title: koeleria cristata var. elatior
intro: Koeleria cristata var. elatior, commonly known as tall June grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. Therapeutically, Koeleria cristata var. elatior is used to treat coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
